puzzle.title: 雨后换乘
puzzle.flavor_text: 每座站台混入了一件不属于另外三件同类事物的行李。先找出每站的异类及其标签，再根据换乘记录恢复唯一线路。
puzzle.content:
| 站台 | 行李 | 异类背面的标签 |
|---|---|---|
| K | copper, iron, silver, willow | O |
| Q | square, triangle, circle, Tuesday | P |
| M | violin, cello, harp, pepper | C |
| R | Paris, Lima, Cairo, helium | S |
| B | robin, eagle, finch, salmon | M |
| T | running, cycling, swimming, marble | S |
| H | apple, pear, peach, beet | A |

换乘记录：
- R 在 H 之后、T 之前。
- Q 紧跟 B。
- K 紧跟 M。
- H 紧跟 Q。
- T 是终点。
- B 紧跟 K。

observations.text: Table has 7 rows: stations K, Q, M, R, B, T, H. Each row lists 4 items under '行李' and one label letter under '异类背面的标签'.

Flavor text: '每座站台混入了一件不属于另外三件同类事物的行李。先找出每站的异类及其标签，再根据换乘记录恢复唯一线路。' (Each platform has one item that doesn't belong to the same category as the other three. First find each station's odd item and its label, then restore the unique route according to the transfer records.)
Station K luggage: copper, iron, silver, willow; label: O
Station Q luggage: square, triangle, circle, Tuesday; label: P
Station M luggage: violin, cello, harp, pepper; label: C
Station R luggage: Paris, Lima, Cairo, helium; label: S
Station B luggage: robin, eagle, finch, salmon; label: M
Station T luggage: running, cycling, swimming, marble; label: S
Station H luggage: apple, pear, peach, beet; label: A

Transfer records: 'R 在 H 之后、T 之前。' (R is after H and before T), 'Q 紧跟 B。' (Q immediately follows B), 'K 紧跟 M。' (K immediately follows M), 'H 紧跟 Q。' (H immediately follows Q), 'T 是终点。' (T is the terminal/end), 'B 紧跟 K。' (B immediately follows K)
Station labels: K=O, Q=P, M=C, R=S, B=M, T=S, H=A. Note labels R and T are both S (duplicate).
Column header '异类背面的标签' means 'label on the back of the odd item'.

In each station, three items belong to one semantic category and one is a distractor: K (metals: copper, iron, silver; odd: willow (tree)), Q (shapes: square, triangle, circle; odd: Tuesday (day)), M (string instruments: violin, cello, harp; odd: pepper (vegetable/spice)), R (capital cities: Paris, Lima, Cairo; odd: helium (element)), B (birds: robin, eagle, finch; odd: salmon (fish)), T (sports/activities: running, cycling, swimming; odd: marble (object/game)), H (fruits: apple, pear, peach; odd: beet (vegetable)).
The odd item labels, by station: K(willow)=O, Q(Tuesday)=P, M(pepper)=C, R(helium)=S, B(salmon)=M, T(marble)=S, H(beet)=A. Sequence of labels by station order K,Q,M,R,B,T,H is O,P,C,S,M,S,A.

Transfer records provide partial order constraints: M->K (K immediately follows M), K->B (B immediately follows K), B->Q (Q immediately follows B), Q->H (H immediately follows Q), H->R (R after H), R->T (T after R), T is terminal. Combined immediate-follow chain: M,K,B,Q,H,R,T (assuming no other stations between, since all immediate except H->R and R->T are 'after' but T is terminal). Station order per constraints: M, K, B, Q, H, R, T.
In constraint-derived order M,K,B,Q,H,R,T, the corresponding labels are: M=C, K=O, B=M, Q=P, H=A, R=S, T=S -> 'COMPASS' (C O M P A S S).

flavor_associations.evidence: Constraints: K after M, B after K, Q after B, H after Q, R after H and before T, T terminal; sequence M-K-B-Q-H-R-T satisfies all.
